caption: The drawing depicts a single carved wooden horse, positioned in profile with its left flank visible. The horse is painted primarily in an off-white or cream color with visible wood grain texture. Its mane and tail are detailed with flowing carved lines. The horse wears a decorative harness colored red with ornamental floral medallions, one on its head and one on its rear. There is a blue ornamental band running horizontally around its body, decorated with raised, circular flower-like motifs. The saddle area features a green and reddish-brown patch, outlined with a thin border, forming a rectangular shape. The raised front left leg and bent back right leg suggest a prancing or walking pose, while its other two legs are straight and support its body. The background is a solid, muted blue, uniformly filling the entire field behind the horse without any additional objects or scenery.
title: Carousel Horse
